subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, VOLLEY is written as WpMMfZ, and DON is written as EpO. How will DENSITY be written in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 
• Letters are increased by +1.

VOLLEY is written as WpMMfZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fb2a203b79f5698c3712d208fc29a13db6acc5a035e8da3fd119bbecaad259b.png] 

And,

DON is written as EpO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0032cea4798400d6a9c82ba90e3eed7e912437540cdb7d3ba69a31a74a80694c.png] 

Similarly,

'**DENSITY**' = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c1a439cb1bb38725e05f488968d5fe88556d2c2a17b8cba133e365f3b09ffbf.png] 

Hence, 'DENSITY' is coded as "**EfOTjUZ**".
